pr_title: [Refactor][Misc] Remove unused shared expert DP flags
source_quote: Since `get_ascend_config` has been **completely removed from** `vllm_ascend/ops/mla.py`, attempting to patch it via `@patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")` in **`test_initialization`** and **`test_forward`** will raise an **`AttributeError`** during test execution. Please remove the `@patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")` **decorators** and the corresponding **`mock_ascend_config` parameters** from both `test_initialization` and `test_forward` to prevent test failures.

--- a/tests/ut/ops/test_mla.py
+++ b/tests/ut/ops/test_mla.py
@@ -3,16 +3,16 @@
         self.mock_quant_config = MagicMock()
 
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_current_vllm_config")
-    @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")          # ← 删①：符号已在 mla.py 整条删除
+    # 删 @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")         # ← 删①
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size")
-    def test_initialization(self, mock_tp_size, mock_ascend_config, mock_get_vllm_config):  # ← 删②
+    def test_initialization(self, mock_tp_size, mock_get_vllm_config):  # ← 删② mock_ascend_config 形参
         mock_mla_attn = MagicMock()
         mock_mla_attn.process_weights_after_loading = MagicMock()
         ...
 
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.torch.ops.vllm.mla_forward")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_current_vllm_config")
-    @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")      # ← 删③：同上，forward 也残留
+    # 删 @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")         # ← 删③
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_forward_context")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ascend_forward_context.get_forward_context")
@@ -21,11 +21,11 @@
         mock_get_forward_context_2,
         mock_get_forward_context,
         mock_tp_size,
-        mock_ascend_config,                               # ← 删④：forward 也残留 mock 形参

         mock_mla_forward,

         mock_tp_size.return_value = 1
